areaNotes: Shangri-La Town (香格里拉镇, Xianggelila Town, formerly Riwa 日瓦) is the entrance town for Yading Nature Reserve, at about 2,800–2,900 m. Several properties in town accept only mainland Chinese documents, so check each one for foreign-passport registration. Trip.com states this for Xianggeli Theme Hotel (No. 19 Luoke Path) and Tiewa Hostel (稻城铁瓦民宿, Ren Village): "This property only accepts guests with a valid travel permit, residence permit, or ID card issued in the Chinese mainland". Oxygen is not essential at about 2,900 m, but several properties offer in-room oxygen generators or oxygen top-ups. A Holiday Inn Express reviewer mentions refilling oxygen bags at the town hospital nearby.
